name: Paper Bride 7 Lethal Bond
detailed_description:
about me

Facebook：@gamefpscom

Twitter：@gamefpscom


About the Game

Speak not of love untouched by passion's fire, as it's a torturous journey.

 If lovers would remain faithful evermore,On Peony Pavilion’s road they’ll meet for three lives more.

Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.

This time, we follow a new protagonist seeking his suddenly-departed lover in a mysterious town that treads between two realms. On this eerie trip, in addition to the addition of Qingqing and Tongtong from Paper Bride 3: Mandarin Pact, many familiar faces also make their return.

Our latest title continues to break new grounds:

* Folk Culture Enhancement — Featuring the same beloved traditional folklore elements fans have come to expect.

* Storyline Expansion — Beloved characters from the Paper Bride universe return in meaningful roles, not merely as Easter eggs.

* Visual Refinement — Everything is heightened: beauty becomes more breathtaking, handsomeness more striking, ugliness more disturbing, and strangeness more unsettling.

* Suspense Intensification — Veterans may be numb to our scares by now, but we still recommend playing before bedtime!

We thank everyone for your continued love and support for the Paper Bride series! We've always wanted our stories to present a Chinese, folk-inspired world to our players. In this latest title, you'll not only be immersed in a tapestry of rich folklore and customs, but also a torrent of paper creatures, surprises, and scares!

Prepare to have your heebies be jeebied in Paper Bride 7!

  • DirectX: Version 9.0
